system.description:
Upon seeing the GLIF, the machine is compelled to hard reboot, shutting down and restarting itself. The machine spends its next action rebooting. After that, it treats the situation as a brand-new scene, and it can be affected by GLIFs it had already been affected by, as a result of the reboot.

However, the machine regains any spent Personal Threat, and adds +2 to that Personal Threat pool for each Injury it has suffered.
